notes.linux: Auth rewritten around Amazon's real device-registration OAuth2 flow (matching the Nile/Heroic client's protocol); confirmed live end-to-end (real account connect, token issuance, GetEntitlements call) but not yet against an account with actual owned games. Install/launch/uninstall are now a from-scratch reimplementation of Amazon's real download protocol (GetGameDownload -> signed/LZMA-compressed SDS manifest -> content-hash-addressed downloads -> fuel.json launch descriptor, run via Proton/Wine with the Fuel SDK env vars real games expect) -- no dependency on the Nile CLI being installed, matching how auth/sync were built. Nile's local library.json is still read as an optional zero-auth sync source when present. Entirely unverified end to end (no owned Amazon game to test against) -- please report back if you own games here.
